title: Biomarkers in Dyspnea
brief_summary: To explore biological mechanisms in human model of induced dyspnea, in order to remove the source of dyspnoea, to modify cerebral impact and to allow the development of targeted therapies.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* healthy volunteers

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* ongoing pain
* respiratory disease
* high levels of depression, panic disorder, or other significant mental health problems
* not fluent in french
